title: UNVERIFIED — The Suspension Bridge Behind the Station

features.name: the bridge
features.desc-on-touch: It spans the gap over the river behind the station. On the far side a dirt path connects to another dirt path.

features.name: instructions, authorship unresolved
features.desc-on-touch: The second washer is under the first. Put the chain through the gate not round the post. Leave the chair with the green seat beside the telephone. Written by her, or by the trees, or by transmission lines. He will not discuss it with his friend.

features.name: a four-wheel drive, surrounded by trees
features.desc-on-touch: Not in view, and then what do you know, turn the corner, there it is.

inscription: like fragments of poetry on broken pots recovered from the bottom of the sea, letters rising
